LanguageData.Cinder_AmorphousWall.label: Amorphous wall
LanguageData.Cinder_AmorphousWall.description: An indescribable amorphous tentacle mixed with a lump of metal, emitting a burnt odor.
LanguageData.Cinder_ErodedEXOBuliding.label: eroded EXO(Not Started)
LanguageData.Cinder_ErodedEXOBuliding.description: A three meter high mass-produced main attack armored mecha, used to fill the gap between infantry and tanks, carrying many weapons and anti tank missiles, and is a component of the armored torrent.\n\nNeed a Mechanitor to activate it.
LanguageData.Cinder_WarAttackerBuliding.label: war attacker(Not Started)
LanguageData.Cinder_WarAttackerBuliding.description: A three meter high heavy armored assault walking machine with astonishing ammunition carrying capacity, like a walking armed helicopter, capable of leveling enemy positions with eight Hellfire missiles.\n\nNeed a Mechanitor to activate it.
LanguageData.Cinder_WarSweeperBuliding.label: war sweeper(Not Started)
LanguageData.Cinder_WarSweeperBuliding.description: A heavy armored anti-aircraft walking machine on the order of three meters high, equipped with anti-aircraft firepower of different calibers and abundant ammunition to accompany infantry in anti-aircraft operations.\n\nNeed a Mechanitor to activate it.
LanguageData.Cinder_erodedKrepostBuliding.label: eroded krepost(Not Started)
LanguageData.Cinder_erodedKrepostBuliding.description: 6M41 / BR-6 "Krepost" NATO nicknamed "TankHead". Huge and bulky walker, used as a bridgehead and mobile battery to maintain frontal battlefield firepower, Krepost is equipped with several active protection system and reactive armors to resist incoming projectiles. Even if the shields are exhausted, its huge size and weapon systems are sufficient at holding off incoming enemies until reinforcements arrive.\n\nNeed a Mechanitor to activate it.
LanguageData.Cinder_TrapIED_HighExplosive.label: Amorphous trap
LanguageData.Cinder_TrapIED_HighExplosive.description: A pair of high-explosive shells connected to a trigger which detonates on touch or bullet impact. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.
LanguageData.Cinder_BlackTentacle.label: tentacle
LanguageData.Cinder_TentacleTrap.label: Tentacle trap
LanguageData.CinderTrapIED_Erosion.label: erosion trap
LanguageData.CinderTrapIED_Erosion.description: A pair of erosion shells connected to a trigger which detonates on touch or bullet impact. Since it is hidden in the surrounding terrain, it cannot be placed adjacent to other traps. Animals can sense these when calm.
